verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's overlap, but the white text straddles the red/blue edge of the T stem ("AGAINST CRUELTY" and "TO ANIMALS" cross or touch it), so it looks accidental. "NOW!" is orphaned on its own line, and the cluster floats centred with dead blue on both sides. B has no collisions and consistent contrast, with a clean left-to-right text block and the T at the right with a margin. It loses the layering, has no size hierarchy in the copy, the text is small for the canvas, and the left side is empty.
